Datasets.Name: projects
Datasets.Description: Project portfolio exported from SQL (dbo.Projects): budget vs spend, status, and schedule. A project is over budget when SpentUsd > BudgetUsd.

Columns.Name: SpentUsd
Columns.Description: Actual spend in USD; SpentUsd > BudgetUsd means over budget.

SampleQuestions: Which projects are over budget (SpentUsd > BudgetUsd)?
Total budget and spend grouped by status

Datasets.Name: customers
Datasets.Description: Customer master exported from SQL (dbo.Customers): sector and region.

Columns.Name: Sector
Columns.Description: Industry sector (Defense, Cyber, Maritime, Aerospace, R&D).

Datasets.Name: work_orders
Datasets.Description: Work orders exported from SQL (dbo.WorkOrders): severity, system area, and hours open.

Columns.Name: HoursOpen
Columns.Description: Hours the work order has been open.

Columns.Name: OpenedDate
Columns.Description: Date the work order was opened.

SampleQuestions: Top severity and system-area combinations by open workload
Work orders by severity with the highest hours open

Datasets.Name: inspection_findings
Datasets.Description: Inspection findings exported from SQL (dbo.InspectionFindings): finding type and result.
SampleQuestions: Which finding types fail most often? Include counts.

Datasets.Name: telemetry_readings
Datasets.Description: Telemetry readings exported from SQL (dbo.TelemetryReadings): metric values and health state.
SampleQuestions: Metrics with frequent critical health state
Average metric value grouped by health state
